hooks.command: jq -c 'if .duration_ms == null then empty else (.duration_ms as $d | "Command took " + (if $d < 1000 then "\($d) ms" elif $d < 60000 then "\($d / 100 | round / 10) s" else "\($d / 60000 | floor) min \($d % 60000 / 1000 | floor) s" end)) as $t | {systemMessage: $t, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: .hook_event_name, additionalContext: ("Start your next message to the user with exactly this line, on its own, then the regular output: " + $t + "\nFor several commands, one line each, in order. Do not mention the times anywhere else.")}} end' 2>/dev/null || true
